findings.comment: Dimensioned floor plans showing layouts and dimensions for each distinct unit type (2-bedroom and 3-bedroom townhomes) are not provided in the site plan submission. Architectural drawings with unit-level floor plan details are not included in the available documentation and cannot be verified.

Floor area data table showing square footage breakdown by floor level (1st floor, 2nd floor, 3rd floor, garage area, covered porches, patios) is not provided for the multi-story townhome unit types. The Building Data Table shows total gross floor area per building but not the SF distribution across floor levels for each unit type.

Mail kiosk is shown on the site plan but is not dimensioned with width and depth dimensions. Provide floor plan dimensions (length and width) for the mail kiosk on the site plan or on a separate detail sheet.

Townhome dwelling unit fire wall separation requirements (1-hour or 2-hour ratings) are not noted on the cover sheet, site plan, or floor plans. Provide fire wall rating designations for wall separations between individual townhome units per applicable building code requirements.

applicableAreas: Site-wide data tables and supplementary applications
findings.comment: Cross-consistency of square footage values across site data table, parking table, TIA worksheet, and Water Benchmarking Application cannot be verified. Site Data Table shows GFA of 83,986 sf, but the benchmarking application is not included in the available documents for comparison. Master comment report (OWB2) indicates pending requirement to ensure GFA consistency with benchmarking application.

Building coverage (roof area) value consistency between site plan and Water Benchmarking Application cannot be verified. Site plan shows 32,296 sf building coverage (34% of site), but the benchmarking application is not provided for direct comparison.

applicableAreas: All residential buildings and unit locations
findings.comment: Fully accessible, Type A adaptable, and Type B adaptable dwelling unit designations are not identified on site plan, floor plans, garage plans, or cover sheet. Residential units must be designated by accessibility type per IBC §§ 1104.2 and 1107.6. Provide unit designations on floor plans, site plan, and cover sheet identifying which units meet fully accessible, Type A, or Type B adaptable requirements.

applicableAreas: Common open space area; potential leasing office location
findings.comment: Public accommodations (leasing offices, fitness centers) and public amenities (courtyards, pools, BBQ areas) are not clearly identified on plans for accessibility documentation. While site plan shows common open space (4,960 sf) and a BBQ pit, their accessibility features and required accessible routes are not explicitly marked for review. Clarify location and type of all public amenities and shared facilities with accessibility markings on site and floor plans.

Water Benchmarking Application submission and Austin Water director approval documentation are not present in the available site plan documentation. Project is a 39-unit multi-family residential development receiving City of Austin (Austin Water) retail service, making WBA submission a condition of site plan approval per LDC § 25-9-413. Master comment report shows this item is pending (OWB2 status) with requirement to submit and ensure consistency with site data table. Additionally, total GFA is 83,986 sf (below 250,000 SF large development threshold), so pre-release director consultation requirement does not apply. Provide WBA approval documentation from Austin Water director as required condition of site plan release.
